omitted_runtime_data: Original copied commands/probes retain exact runtime observations and source Git pins. Review5f cold-commands.json embeds actual stdout/stderr, so no separate runtime log bodies or Git stores are required by its durable artifact manifest. Temporary Git stores are intentionally not public proof intake.
historical_reproduction: Copied review programs and records keep original bytes and relative sibling filenames. Their source-root computations refer to original source paths; reproduce historical probes from their immutable source commits/paths in the inventory, not by treating relocated evidence as a new production gate. Current closure cold/scope controls are executed separately on actual b1.
